_: The single source of truth for everything that identifies this app.
Nothing else in the project should hardcode a name, a version or an
identifier. Change a value here, run `npm run config` in mobile/, and it is
written into brand.js, manifest.json, index.html, capacitor.config.json,
the iOS Info.plist, the Android strings.xml and both store listings.
One name, everywhere, whatever the swearing setting says. The app used to
rename itself when swearing was turned off; it does not any more, because
the name is respectable now and only the mouth is not. Clean name, rude
mouth — the jokes are untouched and still swear by default.
name: Blooming Weather
tagline: A proper weather app that tells you exactly what the sky is doing, then takes the mickey out of it.

_: What the shops are told. It is the app's own name and normally should be
— this exists only because the two listings have their own rules: 30
characters on both, and the name is matched against search terms, so a
listing name sometimes wants to be `Blooming Weather: Forecast` while the
app on the home screen stays `Blooming Weather`.
The name is clean and the content is not, which is a deliberate pairing
rather than an oversight. It also has a consequence: see the age rating
section of STORE.md before filling in either questionnaire. Profanity in
the app is what the rating asks about, not profanity in the name.
store.name: Blooming Weather
store.subtitle: The forecast, with an attitude
